title: Private Document Intelligence Assistant
description: A locally hosted retrieval and document-review workflow over customer-approved files, with source citations and human verification.

prerequisites: Validation of document formats and access controls
integration_notes: Assess existing document repositories before estimating integration effort

title: Workflow and Case Automation
description: A scoped workflow automation service for routing, status tracking, notifications and exception handling across approved business processes.

prerequisites: Access to supported systems or approved APIs
integration_notes: Do not promise integration until target systems and APIs are assessed

title: Field Service and Work-Order Coordination
description: A field operations workflow for work orders, task assignment, service records and operational visibility.

integration_notes: Assess existing CMMS, ERP and workforce systems

title: IoT Condition Monitoring and Alerts
description: A sensor and alerting concept for selected equipment or facility conditions, subject to site survey and hardware compatibility.

integration_notes: No safety-critical control or shutdown functions without separate engineering review

title: Business Systems Integration
description: A scoped integration layer connecting approved systems through documented APIs, files or supported messaging interfaces.

prerequisites: Inventory of source and target systems
integration_notes: Assess authentication, rate limits, data quality and vendor restrictions
